balls.text: Another slower one, heaved to left of Pollard at long-on
slower one again, tapped to the left of Rayudu who makes a half stop
slower cutter around off, run down to Harbhajan at third man. They wanted the second run but they froze as Harbhajan released the throw. And in the end they get that run
the bouncer this time and Shalabh just about manages to stab it away. He was moving to the leg side but that lifter followed him.
The off stump has gone for some cardio training. PK moved outside leg and had a swing. And a miss. It was the slower one and the off stump went cartwheeling.
moves outside leg and pushes the shortish delivery outside off through covers

Pollard again. Munaf again. Again and again. Ryan lifted this slower length delivery to right of long-on and Pollard rushed forward to his right and lunged out to take a low catch. He is delighted. Munna bhai too is delirious.
slower length delivery just outside off stump and Ryan is beaten, stabbing inside the line
leans forward to push-drive it towards long-on and Pollard, rushing in from the deep, fumbles while trying to pick it up
sprays this full and outside leg, all the batsman had to do was get bat to ball and Ryan does that. Munaf screams in agony.
full in length outside off, driven to mid-off region

Viv Richards or Yashpal Sharma? In the end its just DK! He walked across the stumps and wafted the full delivery up in the air. Almost ala King Viv and Yashpal, who played that shot in that 1983 tourney, but this time, unlike those two, DK doesn't get the distance. He has been snapped up at deep backward square-leg
fullish, flicked through backward square-leg for couple of runs
lifter on the middle, DK hops to tuck it close on the leg side for a single
lifting delivery outside off, DK tries the upper cut but no luck

Mandeep is run out. He just about stabbed a slower one to the leg side, say towards short mid-on region. He ran but Malinga rushed. Malinga picked up, turned and swoooshed it across for a direct hit at the non-striker's end.
short in length outside off, steered to wide third man
slower cutter, on the middle, nudged behind square-leg for a single

"It's awesome," says the advertising hoarding at fine-leg and DK has just played his paddle-scoop to that region. He leaned across, crouched, got the bat in position and would have been thrilled to receive a full toss. He just paddled it up and over fine-leg.
full pitched on the middle, just short of yorker length, driven through mid-on
Stylish wallop! It was a short delivery going down the leg side and Mandeep swiveled, lifted his front leg in the air and pulled it over fine-leg boundary. Very cool.
slower bouncer and he tries to upper cut it but can't connect.
gets forward to drive down to long-on
low full toss, driven to the off side
Spontaneous combustion time! He leaned forward to pick out mid-off with his aerial off drive.
yet another bouncer and this climbs over the batsman
the slower bouncer and the batsman ducks
pushed away for a single

Magnificent catch from Pollard. Absolutely awesome. Shaun had killed that shortish ball with a violent pull. Pollard rushed to his right at deep midwicket and lunged out to take it so safely with both hands. He stands, turns towards the crowd and holds his arms aloft. Fabulicious effort.
slower one, just outside off stump, Shaun waits for it to arrive before creaming it, almost flat-batted that, to the wide long-off boundary
around that off stump line, tapped to left of short third man
yet another slower one that beats DK and the keeper. Again, it bounces in front of Rayudu who can't grab it cleanly
almost yorker length, squeezed out to backward point
another slower one, punched out to long-off
slower one outside off, it beats DK and also Rayudu who makes only a half-stop as it bounced awkwardly in front of him
leans forward to push it to the off side for a single

Reverse swept! It almost hits Nita Ambani, sitting just beyond the boundary! Ooh! DK swivelled around and reverse slapped this delivery outside off to the third man boundary. One bounce and for a moment Nita ji must have thought that the white ball was heading towards her. Panic. Frantic wave of the hand and the ball just about tails past her.
slog sweep! This is closer to the off and DK plays his fav slog sweep. And he gets it wide to the right of deep midwicket fielder
tries to fetch it from well outside off and sweep it to the leg side. Too wide for him to reach it
backs away outside leg and punches it to long-on for a single
drags it from outside off to deep midwicket for a single
backs away to push it wide of covers for a single
leans forward to tap it for a single

Dropped by Blizzard What a clanger. DK top-edged the attempted pull and Blizzard ran in from the deep and reached the ball. He waited, cupped the palms upwards and the ball burst through his palms and hit him on the face! Pollard was celebrating when he realised that it was dropped!
steers this to left of short third man for a single
taps this close to the leg side for a single
Punch! It's a back of length delivery just outside off, DK glides forward and punches on the up and to left of long-on. Very nice timing there.
around the off stump, DK gets back to punch it down to long-on
on the middle stump line, Shaun stays adjacent to the line and taps it to cover point
works this through midwicket for a single
nicely bowled; very slow through the air and DK, who was trying to get on the front foot, had to wait for an eternity. He just about pushes it back to the bowler in the end
flicks this aerially but short of deep midwicket fielder
pushed towards mid-off but Suman intercepts with a dive
low dipping full toss - Malinga was looking for the yorker- and DK plays a nice scoopy straight drive. Scoopy doopy doo. He crouched and sliced it over the bowler
short in length outside off, tapped to backward point
The bouncer works. He was hit on the helmet by Malinga's last lifter. This one was on the leg-stump line and Gilchrist is very late on the pull. He just about feathers it to the keeper.
slower one, on the middle stump line, Shaun waits and runs it down to third man
What's with this leg side stuff? Even Malinga does it. Fullish and just outside leg and though the batsman misses out, the ball bounds off the pad to fine-leg boundary
on the pads again, worked to midwicket for a single
gets back to punch this to the off side
stays over the wicket for Gilchrist but floats this full and down the leg side. Neither Gilly nor the keeper can get to it.  Mumbai's bowling has been pretty poor tonight. Too much on the leg side
presses back to cut to deep point region
Thump. Rohit drags this short, from over the stumps, and Marsh waited on the back foot and forced it to the cover boundary
moves outside leg, Rohit follows him, clipped to deep midwicket
Nicely done! He rushed down the track, didn't quite reach the pitch of the ball but he stretched forward and lifted it high over long-on
drifts to the pads, from round the stumps, Gilchrist goes for the sweep but it bounds off his pad
leans forward to ping long-on
on a length ,around off, Gilly's bat-face shuts at point of impact and the ball rolls out to the on side of the pitch
plays the off drive to pick-up a single
Loverly shot. He sashayed down the ground and lifted it to the sight screen. Nice and easy. Good to watch
slower and that keeps low. Cue Harsha Bhogle's trademark "Hmmmm"! Shaun jabbed that to the leg side
floated full from round the stumps, driven to long-on region for couple of runs
on the leg stump line, trying to follows Shaun who was backing away; punched down to long-on
sprays to the pads, clipped through backward square-leg region
backs away but its a full delivery on the middle and he just about managers to stab it to point
drags this short and Gilchrist pulls it but straight to deep midwicket.
slower, fuller, straighter, eased back to the bowler
on the pads, turned through wide midwicket for couple of runs
Poor stuff from Dhawal. Overpitched and well outside off. Blink. The ball is being thrown back from the cover boundary.
he tried this shot against Munaf but ended up mistiming it then. Not this time. He leaned forward and drove this on the up and to the left of mid-off
pushes it to the off side for a single
Dropped by Symonds! Simple chance, really. Gilchrist drove the full delivery straight to short extra cover where Symonds puts down a sitter.
sprays on the leg side. Wide. Punjab would have hoped it was on the leg stump line so that they could have got four leg byes!
leans forward to work it wide of midwicket for a single
And they bowl again on the pads. Shaun, this time, misses out on the leg glance but will collect four leg byes
back of length outside off stump line, tapped away to wide third man
on a length on the middle almost but Shaun twists his body and wrists it to fine-leg region
fuller, a lot straighter, pushed out to mid-off
They are bowling at Gilly's pads. First Harbhajan and now Munaf. Gilchrist presses back to work it to fine-leg boundary. He misses but it runs off the thigh pad
length delivery outside off stump, Marsh tries to punch it on the up but mistimes it to left of mid-off
on the middle stump line, nudged towards midwicket
drifts to the pads this time and Gilchrist gets back to lap it around the corner to fine-leg boundary
lovely skidding toppie, coming in from round the stumps, on the middle stump line, Gilly goes back to stab it to point
closer to the off stump, again slow through the air, and Gilly stumbles forward and defends
tossed up from round the stumps, eased to long-off
drifts to the pads and Gilchrist clips it through backward square-leg. Tendulkar runs and stops as he sees Munaf Jonty hare after it. Jonty of course wins that race
gets back to punch this to mid-off
in the corridor outside off and Marsh shoulders arms
lands short in length on the middle and straightens. Shaun Marsh does what batsmen generally do on Australian tracks. He left it on the length and the ball climbs over middle stump

Paul holes out to deep midwicket. It was a shortish delivery, not quite a bouncer, but on the middle and leg stump line and that does Paul in. He goes for a swat pull but gets more elevation than distance (sorry about that cliche!) and Blizzard waits for it to arrive at the boundary.
More effort in this and this bounces over the middle and leg line. Paul just about manages to sway away from the bouncer
Whack. It was banged in short around off stump and Paul crash-pulls it through midwicket.
short of length, on the middle and leg line, and again Paul is cramped for room. He tries a swat-pull but doesn't make proper contact.
backs away and late cuts to left of short third man  where Malinga makes a diving stop
gets forward to push this to the off
Catch it  was the cry. It was on the leg stump line and Rohit Sharma, at backward square-leg, flew to his left but couldn't get there in time. He got his finger tips to it, I think.
Crashed! flighted outside off stump and Paul lashes out at the width. He lifts it over covers
leans forward to flick it to wide mid-on
gets back to push this back to the bowler
fullish, on the middle and leg line, and again Paul can't do much with that line. he just pushes it a touch uppishly to mid-on
the slower one- he was gunning for the yorker but it just about dips down the leg side. Paul was beaten by the lack of the pace and by that lovely loopy dip
Another bouncer, this time on the middle and leg line - that's the line where Paul has been a touch vulnerable as he gets cramped, this time he ducks

Ouch!  Adam Gilchrist is beaten for pace. It's a screaming bouncer, kicking up viciously, and Gilly just froze. He took his eyes off the ball and tried to duck. Too late. Crash. Clang. The ball rammed into the helmet. Preity Zinta closes her eyes. She can't watch it. Gilly has gone for new helmets.
Ah! the yorker arrives, low dipping full delivery, poked out to point
overpitched again, square driven hard but straight to point. Gilly misses out on a four there. Malinga is yet to hit the right length
Slasher Gilly! Fullish and outside off, not in the yorker length and that allows Gilchrist to slice it up and over backward point
this one skids towards middle and off line, pushed out to mid-on for a single. He was a touch late in playing that shot.
lands on a length outside off and skids in - typical Bhaji delivery to the left-handers - pushed to the off
Swat pick-up! Floated on the leg and middle line, chipped over to deep midwicket
slower, on the middle and leg, worked to midwicket.
turning into the off stump line, pushed back to the bowler
lots of over spin on the first delivery just outside off, steered to backward point
Trapped in front! All over. Stunning collapse this. Low dipping full delivery and Munaf goes for the sweep. He misses and the umpire doesn't. The finger shoots up to the sky. Game over.
Oh dear. yet another tame dismissal. He leaned forward to scoop it back to the bowler. Take it. Catch it. here it is.
leans forward to defend to the off side

Stop the press and all that. They have caught a catch. Whoa! Pollard lifts this high. Very high. Shaun gets under it at long-on. The ball takes an eternity to come down. Shaun waits. The ball arrives and he gets his palms upwards towards the sky. Is it a good move? Will the ball pop out? Shouldn't he hold it the other way? Nope what he does works. The Australian way of taking it has done the trick.
slips down the leg side for a wide

dropped again! This time from Ryan Harris. What a clanger. As Fred Trueman would have said, "What's going OFF out there?!" Pollard pulls and Ryan settles under it at deep midwicket and palms it up and over.
pushed away for a single

Dropped by Mandeep at deep midwicket Pollard pulls this short delivery to deep midwicket and Mandeep just stood there, perhaps thinking the ball would reach him. In the end, he realises he had to get forward. Move Mandeep Move! he eventually rushes forward and lunges out but the ball dies on him and he can't get the palms under it
from round the stumps, short in length, outside off, steered down to third man
gets back to drag-pull it to deep midwicket
Crunchy! The bowler moves to round the stumps now and lands it full on a length around off and middle. Pollard leans forward to cream it, punch it sweetly, over his partner
backs away and punches the length delivery uppishly but just short of mid-off
length delivery outside off, punched through covers

Very nice again! From the bowler this time. Harbhajan went down the track but Bhargav slowed up the pace further. Not quicker but he slowed it up. Harbhajan couldn't adjust to it and ended up swiping across the line. Clatter.
Very nice! What a sweet shot. He sashayed down the track and lifted it almost nonchalantly and the ball landed on the sight screen
skips down the track again but ends up mistiming the drive to covers
moves down the track and ends up lunging to push it to the off
short in length on the middle, swatted past square-leg
Fab shot! he pressed back and punched the short of length delivery through covers. Sweet.
run down to third man for a single
Dropped by Paul at first slip. It's a lifter outside off stump and Harbhajan hops awkwardly and pokes out at it. The ball flew off the edge to right of Paul who palms it off
full in length, on the middle, turned past square-leg
What a soft dismissal! this was a length delivery on the hips, and it has been clipped straight to long leg. Whoa! What a crushing collapse.
length delivery outside off, pushed out to covers
stays round the stumps and fires a bouncer down the leg side
Banged in short around off, from round the stumps and Rayudu top-edges the pull. Tame pull. The ball lobs to mid-on for a simple catch
full delivery from round the stumps, well outside off, driven hard but its intercepted at short extra cover
Slasher! full and outside off, Rayudu goes back and across, reaches out to slash it over backward point
short in length outside off, punched away hard to sweeper cover
banged in short and Suman mistimes the pull but clears mid-on
just outside off stump, Gilly fails to collect it
turned to the leg side
floated full around off, edges his intended off drive to square-leg

Symonds is run out Rayudu drags it to wide of deep midwicket. Symonds turns for the second run but Rayudu stays frozen at the other end. Symonds keeps coming, Rayudu puts his left hand out, suggesting don't. All too late. Symonds had almost reached Rayudu's end!

gets forward to drag it to long-on where Ryan makes a fumble but also a quick recovery. The ball slipped through his fingers; he turned back quickly, rushed, lunged, pushed the ball back in as he fell over the ropes.
on the middle and off, eased back to the bowler
slips down the leg side for a wide

dropped by Gilly It's a full-length delivery curving away in the zone outside off and Symonds lunges forward to jab it off the outer edge. Gilly  flew low to his right, got his right glove to it but couldn't hold on.
Slap-swat! It was banged in short outside off and Symonds flat-batted it over mid-on
moves down the track and punches it to sweeper cover
slower, on a length just outside off, tapped to backward point
in the zone outside off, steered to backward point
on the middle stump line, turned to midwicket
skips down the track and slashes it to third man for a single
cuts in towards off stump, defended to short extra cover
in the channel outside off and Rayudu is beaten, going for a big off drive
leans forward to defend the good-length delivery to backward point. He wants a single but Symonds, wisely, sends him back
Crack! short in length outside off and Rayudu plays a fierce square cut. Symonds loved that shot.
in the zone outside off, left alone
gets behind the line of this length delivery and defends

run out of Rayudu missed. It landed on a length around middle and shaped away. Rayudu was squared-up and edged it towards off. DK rushed in from mid-off and fired a throw at the non-striker's end but was wide off the mark. Rayudu was well short of the crease. PK winces.
length delivery outside off stump, edged away to right of second slip who stops it
fullish around off stump, pushed out to mid-off
full in length around off stump, defended on the front foot
Strangled down the leg side. It seemed a gentle seam-up delivery just outside leg and Blizzard feathers it to Gilchrist!  Three down and wobbling.
just outside off stump, tapped to point

Stumped! This drifted down the leg side and Rohit failed to connect with his leg glance. What's more he lost balance at the point of impact and the back leg was on the line - perhaps not even on the line but just in front of it and the heel is raised in the air. That's out. Nothing grounded behind the line.
taps this to right of square-leg for a single
stretches forward to on drive this for a single
Classy! He leaned well forward and lifted it inside-out over covers. Graceful and elegant.
from round the stumps, slower, fuller, eased to short extra cover
leans forward to flick this full delivery to deep midwicket
leans forward to defend this to the off side
around the off stump line, defended towards covers

PK takes out SRT! Slightly slower, around 127 kmph, length delivery outside off and Tendulkar stumbled out. He ended up lunging forward, bat ahead of the body and ended up steering it to backward point.
peach! It lands on a length around off and tilts away. Tendulkar is comprehensively beaten, pushing inside the line. PK has his hands on the hip and stares down the track.
stays back to tap this length delivery to backward point
on a length just outside off stump, punched out to short extra cover
retains the strike with a wristy dab through midwicket
Aah! It was tossed up outside off, slower, loopy and well outside off, Tendulkar reached across, waited on that front foot to adjust to the slower pace and caressed it to left of cover fielder
takes couple of steps down the track and drives to covers again
slower, full around off, eased to covers
on the middle stump line, nudged between midwicket and square-leg for a single
floated full on the off and middle line, eased to long-off
straighter, driven past the lunging PK to mid-on
In the zone outside off stump, left alone.
edged between the keeper and wide slip. Blizzard pushed out at a length delivery outside off and gets a fat edge.
pushes this outside off but no luck. Adrian goes for the off drive and it runs off the outer half of the bat through point
whippy flick! Full delivery on the middle and leg line, looking for some swing and Blizzard whips it through midwicket
length delivery on the off and middle line, tapped quietly to the on side
